item.title: Kwik Exporter Plugin for Photoshop
item.description: Kwik Exporter Plugin for Photoshop Kwik4 created a project folder where psd files are placed. Kwik5 you can creat a folder for your psd files on your own. When Kwik Exporter opens, it asks for the folder location. Steps to publsh images of layers of . psd files Manually create a project folder with Finder(mac) or Explorer (win), and put your psd files there. In Photoshop, extension > Kwik Open button for selecting your folder of .
